notes.title: Nova-111 is Steam Deck Verified!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9331456/3274ee073f825af218b9a83d24fe8aa2ad7b756b.png[/img]
[h3]The Steam Deck is now officially supported with a native Linux build![/h3]
(Some UI will be automatically scaled up for the smaller screen)

We have gotten reports that the current build has some issues on the Steam Deck with some users, and while we are working with Steam to fix these issues, here is the workaround:

Select [b]Properties[/b], then scroll down to [b]Compatibility[/b], then select [b]Force the use of a specific Steam Play compatibility tool[/b], making sure that [b]Proton 7.0-3[/b] is also selected.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9331456/6f8fb34c27e69203caef08a892d189e5c1c664ea.png[/img]

[h2]For more information and to interact with us directly, join our Discord![/h2]
[url=https://discord.gg/funktroniclabs][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34089288/1385557c7916d7f3ecb704e119168264fe4303e3.png[/img][/url](https://discord.gg/funktroniclabs)

notes.title: Update 1.1 - Level Editor (beta) and New Features
notes.content:
Alright Scientists! Since we’ve launched, we’ve been hard at work squashing bugs and adding more features into Nova-111. Today, we are beyond excited to announce our 1.1 Update that will provide you with some spankin’ fresh new features: 

Level Editor (beta) - that’s right, now you have the ability to craft your own levels and soon be able to share it with the rest of the world! It is live, but still heavily in-development, so we’ve put the editor on the beta-public branch. You can opt into the Beta branch by accessing the Properties Menu in Nova-111. [url=http://nova-111.gamepedia.com/LevelEditor]Editor Wiki[/url]. 

Brazilian Portuguese Language Support - Olá! Como vai? Now our scientist friends in Brazil can now enjoy Nova-111 in their native language. 
Bug Fixes - We have fixed quite a few bugs in the game to provide you with a smoother experience. 

Thanks yall! I hope you enjoy. 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/xBBNSHy.jpg[/img]
